text_block_list.text:
Our training camp life with Tokai Teio 
comes to an end today—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That went by in a flash, didn't it? Feels 
like we just got here the other day.
choice_data_list: It just means it was that fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I guess that makes this training camp a 
huge success then.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The Kikuka Sho will be here before we 
know it, won't it? So we've gotta keep 
working hard even after we get back to the 
academy!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You don't have time to slack off either, 
Trainer! We're in this together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Kikuka Sho! Teio-sama and 
Trainer are coming for ya~!"
